test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The speed of a boat in still water is 17 km/hr and the speed of the stream is 16 km/hr. A man rows to a place at a distance of 26.4 km and comes back to the starting point. Find the total time (in hours) taken by him.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Downstream Speed** (D) = 17 + 16 = 33 km/hr

**Upstream Speed** (U) = 17 − 16 = 1 km/hr

**Total Time** = (Distance ÷ D) + (Distance ÷ U)

**Total Time** = (26.4 ÷ 33) + (26.4 ÷ 1) = 0.8 + 26.4 = 27.2 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 27.2 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/122dcf05a69d6c330b9838efd12a0daedae175ee9adeab3c05f58b81b8a1c18e.png] 

**Given:**

**Speed of boat** (u) = 17 km/hr

**Speed of stream** (v) = 16 km/hr

**Distance** (d) = 26.4 km

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Downstream Speed = u + v

Upstream Speed = u − v

**Calculations:**

⇒ Downstream Speed = 17 + 16 = 33 km/hr

⇒ Upstream Speed = 17 − 16 = 1 km/hr

⇒ Time taken downstream (t₁) = 26.4 ÷ 33 = 0.8 hours

⇒ Time taken upstream (t₂) = 26.4 ÷ 1 = 26.4 hours

⇒ Total Time = t₁ + t₂ = 0.8 + 26.4 = 27.2 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 27.2 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Downstream Speed

When the boat moves in the direction of the stream, its effective speed is the sum of the boat speed and stream speed (u + v).

Upstream Speed

When the boat moves against the direction of the stream, its effective speed is the difference between the boat speed and stream speed (u − v).

Average Speed for Round Trip

The average speed for a boat going to a point and returning is given by: Average Speed = (Downstream Speed × Upstream Speed) ÷ Speed of Boat in Still Water.</p
